Resolves #19135

Password, Hidden, Search and Display now have native component witnesses. Display also restores its documented readonly default through Text's inherited reactive `readOnly` config; its constructor keeps the existing tab-order rule and stops replacing the boolean readonly value with a string that initial rendering discards. Switch keeps its existing native witness.

Evidence: L3 (real App Worker instances and rendered field DOM, including editability) → L3 required (the five preset rows). Residual: none within the amended preset scope.

| AC-2 | CI-covered: four new cases cover Password, Hidden, Search and Display. Existing `component/form/field/Switch.spec.mjs` supplies the fifth row without duplicate tests, as the author amended. |
| AC-3 | Only the author's permitted Display source exception changes production code. The retained readonly assertion was red on unchanged source; the inherited config plus removal of the string overwrite makes it green. |

The field source/spec blobs are unchanged; the seven focused cases passed again afterwards. Hosted current-head full-tier checks remain a pre-merge gate. |

## Deltas from ticket

The current-source intake found Switch already covered, and Display's documented readonly behavior absent from the DOM. The author [amended the existing ticket](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19135) for both findings; no new ticket or base-field change. The [claimer's Contract Ledger](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19135#issuecomment-6689584006) records the Display exception.

Display also receives Text's existing `neo-readonly` styling and hides configured triggers; the visible consumers include `examples/stateProvider/advanced` and `examples/component/process/realWorldExample`.

Placement follows the existing native form component specs and `component/component/Image.spec.mjs`; no new fixture app, runtime directory or dependency.

The inherited dynamic readonly-update problem is outside this preset repair, recorded in the source-finding comment and defect-note `ee94bbee52603fdd`. This PR restores initial rendering and makes no claim to repair later Text/renderer transitions.

## Test Evidence

Unchanged-source native run: Password/Hidden/Search passed; Display failed because its actual input lacked `readonly`. The same assertion remains. A separate live control showed plain Text constructed with `readOnly:true` emits the native readonly attribute and blocks typing; Display's constructor overwrote that boolean with `'readonly'`. The corrected preset follows the existing boolean/reactive path.

Hidden's same-instance unhide/rehide control prevents a missing-element assertion from passing vacuously. Display checks both the attribute and native editability, plus tabindex and absent clear trigger.

### 🧭 Patch-Blind Premise Snapshot

*   **Inputs Read Before Patch:** #19135 body as amended today (Switch row already pinned; Display exception), `src/form/field/Text.mjs` at `dev` (`readOnly_`, `afterSetReadOnly`, `afterSetEditable`, `updateReadOnlyState`), `src/form/field/Display.mjs` at `dev`, the theme files for `--textfield-*-readonly`, and the sibling pattern `component/component/Image.spec.mjs`.
*   **Expected Solution Shape:** One native component spec with a case per remaining row. For Display, the readonly attribute should come from Text's single owner of the key (`updateReadOnlyState`, fed by the `readOnly` config). A second imperative write from the subclass is the shape to avoid. No change to Text itself.
*   **Patch Verdict:** Matches. Display now declares `readOnly: true` and drops its `inputEl.readonly = 'readonly'` write, so the `readonly` key has one owner. `tabindex` stays imperative in `construct`, which Text does not own.
*   **Premise Coherence:** Coheres with verify-before-assert. The source finding was posted on the ticket before any `src` edit, and a wrong control interpretation was corrected in place.
